meta.description: T18 golden route evaluation set: the regression corpus that pins routing quality as measurable positive+negative behaviour instead of one more round of rule tuning. Consumes the real skills/scripts/community-route.py through subprocess (exit codes included). Complements, never replaces, skills/tests/community-decoys.json (the D8 negative control) and the 13 ranking cases in test-route-ranking.py.
meta.consumer: skills/scripts/test-golden-route.py; U9 pins are additionally asserted inside skills/scripts/test-community-route.py
meta.deps: stdlib only; no packages, no network, no stateful git

budgets.note: Every case except golden-err-overbudget must satisfy wrappers<=5 and total_shown_references<=50. The over-budget case asserts the engine refuses with blocked/budget_exceeded/exit-20 instead of silently truncating.

meta.u9_note: Cases with pin_u9=true encode docs/community/ROUTING-SIGNAL-U9.md as EXPECTED behaviour: the 5 items U9 registered as unfixable (governance-word-governance, governance-word-wrapper, alias-delivery-cjk, hypernym-endpoint-top, hypernym-application-top) plus the s3 absence guard. If a future change 'fixes' one of them, the golden set goes RED on purpose so the fix must consciously amend U9 instead of slipping through silently.

cases.name: golden-ctf-en
cases.why: English CTF positive: a hint carrying two alias tokens must be won by the reversing record over the APK records of the same wrapper. Measured 2026-10-01: matched, exit 0, top ctf-reverse.

cases.name: golden-ctf-cjk
cases.hint: 磁盘镜像 隐写分析 事件日志 证据恢复
cases.why: Pure-Chinese CTF positive with no English token at all: the forensics record must be reached by its evidence-handling vocabulary. Measured 2026-10-01: matched, exit 0, top ctf-forensics.

cases.name: golden-ctf-crypto-mixed
cases.hint: Coppersmith LWE 格攻击 填充预言机
cases.why: Mixed English+Chinese CTF positive, the situation the alias lexicon exists for. Measured 2026-10-01 via CLI: matched, exit 0, 2 wrappers, top ctf-crypto.

cases.name: golden-api-en
cases.why: English API/Web positive: the name match must outrank description mentions of a related record. Measured 2026-10-01: matched, exit 0, top sqli-sql-injection.

cases.name: golden-api-cjk
cases.why: Chinese API/Web positive: a Chinese alias hint that only widens to a name hit still has to win the order. Source filter is required: unfiltered, the same hint is a 3-wrapper ambiguous tie (needs_review), which golden-ambiguous-jwt covers separately.

cases.name: golden-api-auth
cases.why: English API auth positive inside one wrapper; the bare word JWT without a filter is ambiguous instead (see golden-ambiguous-jwt). Measured 2026-10-01: matched, exit 0, 3 wrappers, top api-auth-and-jwt-abuse.

cases.name: golden-apk-en
cases.why: APK positive with no source filter: tool-led Android assessment must surface the APK extension wrapper first. Measured 2026-10-01 via CLI: matched, exit 0, 4 wrappers, top apk-reverse-community skills/apk-reverse.

cases.name: golden-delivery-en
cases.why: Delivery positive proving the U9 alias-attribution fix holds at the reference layer: the pipeline word must reach ci-cd-pipeline, not the RAG pipeline record. Measured 2026-10-01 via CLI: matched, exit 0, top ci-cd-pipeline.

cases.name: golden-delivery-cjk
cases.hint: 交付流程 需求评审
cases.why: Chinese Delivery positive: a multi-word delivery request must reach the end-to-end delivery record (215). Measured 2026-10-01 via CLI: matched, exit 0, 1 wrapper, top e2e-feature-delivery.

cases.name: golden-signal-tool
cases.why: Realistic multi-word tool phrasing carried by the curated signal layer; the case that regresses first if signals stop being consumed. Measured 2026-10-01: matched, top active-directory-acl-abuse.

cases.name: golden-desc-only
cases.why: Description-only route with no source filter: the term exists only in the description, the anti-over-narrowing guard a negatives-only corpus cannot supply. Measured 2026-10-01 via CLI: matched, exit 0, top web-vulnerability.

cases.name: golden-kerberos
cases.why: Single-word domain positive, minimal-budget anchor (1 wrapper, 1 reference). Measured 2026-10-01 via CLI: matched, exit 0, top active-directory-kerberos-attacks.

cases.name: golden-lowconf-mimikatz
cases.why: Low-confidence positive: reachable only through a curated signal, so score is 0 and confidence is 0.0 by design (confidence stays a statement about token evidence). Must be needs_review, exit 10, record present. Measured 2026-10-01 via CLI: needs_review, exit 10.

cases.name: golden-lowconf-lattice
cases.why: Low-confidence positive (D2 widening class): the description holds only Lattice-based. Must stay reachable and needs_review rather than matched. Measured 2026-10-01: needs_review with source filter.

cases.name: golden-plural-pcaps
cases.why: Plural-class recall (D3): user-typed plural carried by the alias fold. Correction note: first drafted as needs_review/exit-10 from an unfiltered probe, but measured 2026-10-01 with the hack-skills filter it is a single-wrapper confident matched, exit 0. Golden records the measured value, not the assumption.

cases.name: golden-ambiguous-jwt
cases.why: Ambiguity anchor: the bare cross-source word must require review, carry candidates+confidence+reason, and must NOT be hideable with --limit (asserted in test-community-route.py). Measured 2026-10-01 via CLI: needs_review, exit 10, 3 wrappers, top ctf-super-hub.

cases.name: golden-err-blank
cases.why: Error input: blank hint must be missing_input naming the missing field, exit 21. Already pinned in test-community-route.py; repeated here so the golden report covers the error class.

cases.name: golden-err-punct
cases.why: Error input: punctuation-only hint tokenises to the empty set and must be missing_input, exit 21. Measured 2026-10-01 via CLI: missing_input, exit 21.

cases.name: golden-err-stopword
cases.why: Error input that doubles as the D5 fix anchor: stopped before alias substitution, tokens(workflow) is empty, lookup is missing_input with 0 candidates. Measured 2026-10-01: missing_input.

cases.name: golden-err-overbudget
cases.why: Context-budget anchor: 68 references across 4 wrappers exceeds MAX_TOTAL_REFERENCES=50, so the engine must refuse with blocked/budget_exceeded/exit-20 plus budget/required_action/confirmation instead of silently truncating. Measured 2026-10-01 via CLI: blocked, exit 20.

cases.name: u9-governance-word-governance
cases.why: U9 registered UNFIXABLE: sense collision between registry governance vocabulary and genuine DeFi DAO-governance domain text; stopping the word would kill recall for legitimate multi-word governance-takeover queries. Golden pins the over-trigger as expected: status matched, top defi-attack-patterns. A future change that alters this top MUST consciously amend U9.

cases.name: u9-governance-word-wrapper
cases.why: U9 registered UNFIXABLE: the engine's own vocabulary word answered by a path-traversal record whose text genuinely discusses PHP stream wrappers. Same structure as the governance pin; the decoy encodes a stricter standard than wrong. Golden pins top path-traversal-lfi.

cases.name: u9-alias-delivery-cjk
cases.why: U9 two-layer pin. REFERENCE layer is FIXED: the U9 signal moved the top from the RAG record to 215 e2e-feature-delivery, the legitimate answer, and golden asserts reference_top stays 215. WRAPPER layer is registered UNFIXABLE: all 29 candidates sit in one wrapper so no deterministic order can dethrone the delivery wrapper without stopwording the word (which would delete the just-restored correct top), and golden asserts wrapper_top stays ai-fullstack-delivery. Wrapper-level tolerance must never be misread as overall failure.

cases.name: u9-hypernym-endpoint-top
cases.why: U9 registered UNFIXABLE: bare hypernym over 11 description-tied candidates across two wrappers with no evidence favouring any leader; any deterministic reorder only moves the red dot to the next path-sorted record. Golden pins top 401-403-bypass-techniques. Measured 2026-10-01 via CLI: matched, exit 0, 2 wrappers, top 401-403-bypass.

cases.name: u9-hypernym-application-top
cases.why: U9 registered UNFIXABLE: bare hypernym over 14 candidates, Android record leads on a single description mention; the bare word has no owning answer without a relevance model. Golden pins top android-pentesting-tricks. Measured 2026-10-01: matched, 1 wrapper, top android-pentesting-tricks.

cases.name: u9-absence-s3-bucket
cases.why: U9 absence guard, CORRECT behaviour not a defect: no record in the 293-skill corpus owns S3 or object storage (bucket in 0/293 routing texts), so the hint must reach nothing and no bucket keyword or signal may ever be invented for it. Golden pins needs_review, exit 10, 0 wrappers, 0 candidates. Measured 2026-10-01 via CLI: needs_review, exit 10.

cases.name: x-r46-xslt
cases.why: Card Z fixed gap R46: the xslt-injection specialist record (1/103 hack-skills, slug skills/xslt-injection) had no natural-phrasing keyword on the master side, so the hint fell to R0/low. Community side always matched it (matched, exit 0, top xslt-injection). Golden pins both sides now agree: master R46/high and community hack-skills/xslt-injection. Measured 2026-10-01 after fix on both CLIs.

cases.name: x-r47-brainstorm
cases.hint: CTF 头脑风暴先理清题意
cases.why: Card Z fixed gap R47: CTF plus Chinese triage words (头脑风暴, from the brainstorming record and ctf-beginner-hub auto-triage prose) matched no R47 pattern, so master fell through to the generic R41 sandbox. The added R47 keyword requires CTF context (mustAll) so generic product brainstorming is not absorbed. Master is medium because R41 also matches bare CTF, which is correct shared-word behaviour. Community side is matched with wrapper ctf-super-hub (reference-level top is engine ranking, only the wrapper is pinned here). Measured 2026-10-01 after fix.

cases.name: x-r48-cicd
cases.hint: 公司要上 CI/CD 交付流程
cases.why: Card Z lead symptom: this exact hint went to R0/low on master while community-route matched it at confidence 1.0, because R48 had no ci/cd or 交付流程 pattern (8 alternatives, none covered). The added R48 keyword carries ci.?cd and the compound 交付流程 (never bare 交付, excluded per U9). Both sides now agree on e2e-feature-delivery. Before-fix master output is recorded in docs/community/ROUTE-COVERAGE.md. Measured 2026-10-01 after fix on both CLIs.

cases.name: x-r49-resign
cases.why: Card Z fixed gap R49: re-sign/重签名 is literal capability vocabulary of the single apk-reverse-community record (keywords and legacy_description: patch or re-sign Android APKs) but had no master keyword, so the hint fell to R0/low. Ordinary APK work (frida 脱壳安卓 APK) still resolves R1 because the added pattern uses only capability compounds, never bare patch/frida/smali/重打包. Community side matched throughout. Measured 2026-10-01 after fix on both CLIs.

cases.name: x-gap-beginner
cases.why: REGISTERED gap, not a defect: bare 新手入口 without any CTF context stays at master fallback R0/low and community no_match, by deliberate choice. The ctf-beginner-hub record owns the phrase only inside CTF triage, and routing bare 新手入口 to R47 would absorb generic product onboarding queries (overbroad per the U9 rule: no owning record for the bare phrase). A CTF-qualified phrasing (x-r47-brainstorm) routes correctly. This case pins the current behaviour so a future widening must be conscious.

cases.name: x-gap-nosql
cases.why: REGISTERED by design, not a defect: the nosql-injection community record exists (1/103 hack-skills) and community-route reaches it, but master deliberately keeps the whole SQLi family on canonical R11 (the R46 note reserves API/SQLi/SSRF for their stronger canonical routes). R46 was intentionally NOT given nosql, and since R46 outranks R11 adding it would steal the family. This case pins master R11/high so the boundary stays visible.

cases.name: x-gap-doctor
cases.hint: doctor 预检工具链怎么跑
cases.why: REGISTERED gap, not a defect: bare doctor without APK context stays at master fallback R0/low and community no_match, by deliberate choice. The APK doctor (scripts/doctor.py) is reachable once APK context is present via the existing apk.?doctor pattern; routing bare doctor to R49 would absorb medical/PhD/undirected tooling queries. This case pins the current behaviour so a future widening must be conscious.

cases.name: x-gap-upload-community
cases.why: REGISTERED community-side CJK gap, re-measured open on 2026-10-01: the Chinese hint shares no token with the English-only upload-insecure-files record, so community-route reports needs_review with zero wrappers. Boundary evidence that the capability exists: the English hint upload reaches skills/upload-insecure-files/SKILL.md (matched, hack-skills) and bare 文件上传 reaches ctf-web. Master side is tracked separately in x-gap-upload-master (R46/high since the master fix); do not widen community aliases here just to force a match.

cases.name: x-gap-upload-master
cases.why: Master side of the former x-gap-upload asymmetry, FIXED and re-measured on 2026-10-01: master reaches R46/high via slug evidence (upload-insecure-files plus strix-insecure-file-uploads). Split out from the old single dual-side case so each side owns its pin: this case asserts the master fix holds (community side deliberately skipped here), x-gap-upload-community asserts the community CJK gap stays registered.

cases.name: x-neg-s3
cases.why: Negative control: a cloud-storage assessment adjacent to delivery wording (评估 also appears in R11) must stay on canonical R23 and must NOT be absorbed by any new R46-R49 keyword. Master is medium because R11 also matches 安全评估, which is correct shared-word behaviour. Community side is needs_review with zero wrappers (U9 absence guard holds). Measured 2026-10-01 after fix.

cases.name: x-neg-diagram
cases.why: Negative control: an architecture-diagram request (微服务 also appears in delivery backend records) must stay on canonical R39 and must NOT be absorbed by the new pipeline/devops/R48 or websocket/R46 keywords. Community side is needs_review with zero wrappers. Measured 2026-10-01 after fix.

cases.name: x-neg-report
cases.why: Negative control, tightened 2026-10-01: a report-writing request mentioning 逆向 must stay out of all community routes (master R0/high on the single 逆向 hit). Community side is needs_review but NOT zero wrappers: it returns a 2-wrapper ambiguous_tie (ctf-super-hub ctf-reverse plus hack-skills), so golden pins min_wrappers 2 as the floor. Absorption into a single wrapper, a flip to matched, or a collapse to no_match all go red. Measured 2026-10-01 on both CLIs.

cases.name: x-neg-llm
cases.why: Negative control, tightened 2026-10-01: an LLM prompt-injection request (注入 also appears across the R46 injection vocabulary) must stay on canonical R14/high and must NOT be absorbed by R46. Community side is needs_review but NOT zero wrappers: a 3-wrapper ambiguous_tie whose hack-skills candidate is the genuine skills/llm-prompt-injection/SKILL.md record, so golden pins min_wrappers 2 as the floor against single-wrapper absorption (measured 3 wrappers on 2026-10-01; floor 2 tolerates ranking churn). Measured 2026-10-01 on both CLIs.

cases.name: x-neg-forensics
cases.why: Negative control, still holds on 2026-10-01 but hint-specific: the long phrasing 内存转储取证分析 must stay on canonical R25/high and out of R46-R49, with community no_match (zero wrappers). Boundary evidence: the shorter 内存取证 DOES reach skills/memory-forensics-volatility/SKILL.md (matched, hack-skills) with master R25/high, and that fixed capability is pinned separately in x-pos-memory-cjk. Widening aliases to absorb the long phrasing needs its own card, never a silent threshold change. Measured 2026-10-01 on both CLIs.

cases.name: x-pos-memory-cjk
cases.why: Fixed-capability pin added 2026-10-01: the short CJK hint reaches the memory-forensics-volatility specialist on community (matched, exit 0, top hack-skills/skills/memory-forensics-volatility) and canonical R25/high on master, so both sides agree and the kind is cross-fixed, not a gap. It bounds x-neg-forensics: only the longer 内存转储取证分析 phrasing stays a registered community no_match. Measured 2026-10-01 on both CLIs.
